thematic_state.standing_law: thematic_state is DISPLAY/CONTEXT ONLY (TIL W5). Nothing here may originate a signal, raise a score, gate, size, or rank. risk_radar_reliability.standing_law: risk_radar_reliability is DISPLAY/CONTEXT ONLY. Rates are graded forward-ledger history (deterministic math over committed rows). No LLM, no model scores, no signal origination anywhere in this lobe. hit_rate=null means insufficient_n (< 5 graded rows) — not a confirmed miss. Nothing here may gate, rank, size, or escalate any alert or position. Use 'hit rate' and 'track record' in user-facing copy (CI-guards bar the v-word).
